Cost-effectiveness of SGLT2 inhibitors in HFpEF

An individual-level, continuous-time multi-state model that reproduces Cohen et al., JAMA Cardiol. 2023;8(5):419-428 (doi:10.1001/jamacardio.2023.0077), then extends it with adverse-event costs and generic availability.

Built entirely on hesim (Incerti D, Jansen JP; GPL-3).

Report
Reproduction Validation for base case.
Extension Incorporating cost of adverse-effects and generic availability of Dapagliflozin
Slides Presentation for results analyses and development process.

Licensing follows NOTICE: MIT for code, CC BY 4.0 for prose and generated figures, with the AMA figure and the CSL file carved out. No patient-level data.
